name: Renaissance Pattaya Resort & Spa
short_description: Renaissance's beachfront resort on Na Jomtien's quieter coast south of central Pattaya, with 257 sea-view rooms, direct beach access and two large pools including an adults-only ocean-view infinity pool.
ai_summary: Renaissance Pattaya Resort & Spa is a 257-room, five-star beachfront property set on the tranquil Na Jomtien coast about 18 km south of central Pattaya, deliberately positioned as a calm retreat away from the city's nightlife. Independent write-ups consistently describe a surprising sense of serenity on arrival, with contemporary design drawing on local fishing-village motifs and natural materials. Accommodation spans seven-plus categories from spacious sea-view balcony rooms to pool-access rooms and beachfront villas, widely praised as clean, modern and generously sized with strong ocean and pool views. The resort's two large outdoor pools, including an adults-only infinity pool overlooking the sea, direct beach access, day spa, fitness center and kids' club draw families and couples alike. Dining centers on 609 Kitchen for all-day international and seafood buffets and Pebbles Bar & Grill for grilled dishes, with breakfast variety and quality frequently singled out. Marriott Bonvoy guests report generous elite recognition, with reliable upgrades and complimentary breakfast for Platinum members, a rare perk among area resorts. The most common watch-out is the remote location: reaching central Pattaya, restaurants or convenience stores requires a drive or taxi, so it suits travelers wanting a self-contained beach base rather than easy access to the city's bars and attractions. TripAdvisor rates it 4.0 of 5 across roughly 1,300 reviews, ranking it around fourth of thirty hotels in Na Chom Thian.

faqs.question: Where is Renaissance Pattaya Resort & Spa located?
faqs.answer: The resort sits beachfront on the quieter Na Jomtien coast in Sattahip District, about 18 km south of central Pattaya. It is roughly a 30-minute drive from U-Tapao Rayong-Pattaya International Airport and around 120 km southeast of Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport.

faqs.question: What are the pools and beach like?
faqs.answer: The resort has direct access to a calm stretch of Na Jomtien beach plus two large outdoor pools. One is an adults-only infinity pool overlooking the ocean, while the second is family-friendly. Some rooms and villas offer direct pool access from their patios.

faqs.question: Is it good for Marriott Bonvoy elite members?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests report generous elite recognition, including reliable room upgrades and complimentary breakfast for Platinum members, which is uncommon among resorts in the area. The property is fully Bonvoy-enrolled, so stays earn and redeem points and elite night credit as normal.
